      "observations": [
        "All106 owned file diffs were read in four bounded parts, with actual NUL path verification. This is a test/build/helper patch, not production message handling. The full migration inventory records exact old/new Git blobs for every path. No Suite files are involved.",
        "The new MessageInjectionHelpers module eagerly constructs its generator, scenario factory and local MessageInjection when that module is imported, exporting inboxFolder and six generation/injection/deletion helpers. FolderDisplayHelpers drops these imports/exports/construction; it still acquires a 3pane window and keeps its old harness guard. This is an explicit import boundary, not lazy initialization inside MessageInjectionHelpers and not removal of every import side effect.",
        "create_folder stops awaiting display completion/MessageInjection.makeEmptyFolder and synchronously creates a named Local Folders child, setting Mail plus each optional flag. get_special_folder passes [aFolderFlag]. create_virtual_folder now takes (folderName,searchFolders), creates an ALL offline-search virtual folder through VirtualFolderHelper and returns its underlying folder. All changed virtual-folder callers adopt name-first arguments; unnamed new folders gain explicit names. Existing awaits of a synchronous returned folder remain valid but no longer imply a display-completion wait.",
        "Explicit account/server/identity preference blocks replace reliance on implicit injection startup in eight existing manifest areas, with a distinct account-bearing folder-pane configuration. The no-account action-button scenario moves to its own manifest/test and gets build registration. It starts clean without deleting shared accounts, creates one POP account, observes button enablement and removes it. The account-setup tab test drops prior delete-all/restore-local-account work; that historical file is absent at the accepted revision, so no invented current snapshot is supplied.",
        "All changed import hunks move generation/injection symbols to the packaged new module while folder/UI helpers stay in FolderDisplayHelpers. The moved wrapper functions preserve await/delegation contracts and the same shared generator/injection instance. This audit covers each changed importer hunk; it does not claim every unrelated test body was reread or run.",
        "AccountColors adds a local identity only if absent; folder-pane expected count removes the implicit Inbox; header cleanup removes smart mailboxes. The new isolated test has three nonempty direct assertions and condition-wait messages. They describe expected state without should; this alone is not a review defect. The row-count helper has a concrete expected/actual error; the changed column scenario calls a custom helper that checks unexpected visible/hidden columns. New assertions are not mistaken for tests being executed.",
        "The stale synchronous/event-loop-spin comment is removed; implementation becomes synchronous only for folder creation, not every folder-display operation. The flags type becomes an array and JSDoc parameter separators/license header are source-checked. The virtual-folder JSDoc still mentions an IMAP URI return even though this wrapper always uses localRoot and wrapped.virtualFolder; implementation governs the scoped contract. Existing var/export and snake_case test APIs stay as local compatibility evidence, not new naming policy.",
